boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: The first Git source probe ran from the nonrepository app directory and returned not a git repository.
records.passing_witness: The exact source worktree resolved the expected branch and final head.
records.recovery: Move every Git probe to the exact Liora source worktree before retrying.
records.recurrence_guard: Always bind Git commands to a verified worktree path.
records.rollback: Credit no probe from an unrelated directory and mutate nothing.
records.sibling_recommendation: Resolve the repository root before any Git command.

records.failed_witness: A combined PowerShell source-verifier expression had a pre-execution parser fault around a nested cat-file expression.
records.passing_witness: The bounded scalar verifier proved exact anchors, direct parents, zero merges, clean state, and four-way equality.
records.recovery: Split the verifier into scalar expressions and explicit ancestry checks.
records.recurrence_guard: Avoid nested native-command expressions inside a large PowerShell object literal.
records.rollback: The parser fault earned zero verification credit and changed no state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use small scalar Git probes for lifecycle anchors.

records.failed_witness: An overwide activation projection exceeded the visible output budget and truncated.
records.passing_witness: Every baton range, including the truncated interval, was read through EOF.
records.recovery: Read the baton in exact bounded windows through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Inventory long files and use bounded line windows.
records.rollback: No partial display earns read-through credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Record every truncated interval and recover only the missing range.

records.failed_witness: A second 801-to-1080 activation window exceeded the model context budget.
records.passing_witness: The missing interval and all later lines were read in smaller exact windows.
records.recovery: Reduce the requested window and continue sequentially.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep each long-document window below the current display budget.
records.rollback: Retain the failed projection at zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Shrink only the failed window; do not restart the whole read.

records.failed_witness: The first skill inventory used a foreach block directly before a pipeline and PowerShell reported an empty pipe element.
records.passing_witness: The recovered inventory reported every selected skill and reference without parser ambiguity.
records.recovery: Materialize rows into an array before ConvertTo-Json.
records.recurrence_guard: Materialize foreach results before piping in PowerShell.
records.rollback: The parser fault changed no file and earned zero credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer explicit arrays for bounded PowerShell inventories.

records.failed_witness: A raw authorization-state display exceeded the visible output bound and truncated.
records.passing_witness: The full current authorization JSON was read and its owner-self-scoped delta rules were applied.
records.recovery: Read the authorization state in complete 200-line windows through EOF.
records.recurrence_guard: Measure large JSON before raw display and page it deterministically.
records.rollback: No truncated authorization view authorizes mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use bounded exact windows for large state files.

records.failed_witness: The first receipt-bank inventory repeated the foreach-pipeline parser fault.
records.passing_witness: The recovered bounded inventory located the exact canonical receipt and its digest.
records.recovery: Materialize receipt rows before serialization.
records.recurrence_guard: Use one proven materialized-array wrapper for repeated inventories.
records.rollback: The failed wrapper changed no receipt or repository state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Reuse the passing array wrapper instead of reproducing the parser fault.

records.failed_witness: The first manifest inventory repeated the foreach-pipeline parser fault.
records.passing_witness: The recovered inventory identified all lifecycle manifests and staged-review contracts.
records.recovery: Materialize manifest rows and inspect their real keys before projection.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect schema keys before composing a projection.
records.rollback: No manifest credit follows from a failed projection.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use literal manifest allowlists and materialized rows.

records.failed_witness: An rg expression for toolkit functions contained an unclosed grouped pattern because of quoting.
records.passing_witness: The bounded search located the profile builder, hardening dispatch, and CLI surfaces.
records.recovery: Use multiple literal -e expressions instead of one compound group.
records.recurrence_guard: Prefer several exact patterns over a fragile compound regex on PowerShell.
records.rollback: The failed search changed nothing and earned no discovery credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use literal or separately quoted rg expressions.

records.failed_witness: The first full read-only manifest comparison returned no attributable payload within its window.
records.passing_witness: The recovered comparison proved 79 paths, blobs, modes, sizes, and SHA-256 values exactly.
records.recovery: Replace the wrapper with a bounded git cat-file batch comparison and scalar summary.
records.recurrence_guard: Drain Git batch pipes and emit a small scalar receipt.
records.rollback: An unattributable wrapper receives zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use communicate-style batch plumbing and concise summaries.

records.failed_witness: An evidence staged-digest candidate projection exceeded the available model context despite a bounded intent.
records.passing_witness: The 99-entry canonical manifest and exact staged-review receipts remained independently digest-bound.
records.recovery: Rely on the already verified full owner manifest and use tiny scalar path-count checks only.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not expand staged candidate payloads when exact commit-local manifests already bind them.
records.rollback: The truncated projection earned zero credit and replayed no canonical check.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer exact scalar counts over redundant expanded digest candidates.

records.failed_witness: The first combined branch, path, worktree, and remote uniqueness wrapper returned no attributable output in its window.
records.passing_witness: Each split probe proved the Tamar slug, branch, path, and remote ref unique.
records.recovery: Split uniqueness into local branch, path, worktree-list, and live-remote probes.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep network and local uniqueness probes separate.
records.rollback: The combined wrapper created nothing and earned zero uniqueness credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Require attributable scalar evidence before lane creation.

records.failed_witness: A second combined local uniqueness wrapper again returned no attributable output at the short window.
records.passing_witness: The exact local branch was absent, the path was absent, and the worktree was unlisted.
records.recovery: Use direct quiet show-ref, literal Test-Path, and bounded worktree-list checks.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not wrap several Git plumbing commands behind a short unattributable window.
records.rollback: The wrapper mutated nothing and cannot count as a pass.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use one scalar probe per uniqueness condition.

records.failed_witness: A cleanliness probe executed after --no-checkout but before read-tree and reported 73421 apparent deletions with zero materialized files.
records.passing_witness: The lane then had zero status rows and exactly four initial materialized files.
records.recovery: Populate the already configured sparse index with read-tree -mu HEAD before accepting cleanliness.
records.recurrence_guard: Treat the no-checkout state as transitional and never assess cleanliness before sparse materialization.
records.rollback: The premature status result earned zero cleanliness credit and no file was deleted.
records.sibling_recommendation: Configure sparse patterns first, materialize second, then inspect status.
